Q: I want to pull biological classification information from wikipedia pages A:

Why wiki? Wikipedia is an encyclopedia, not database. Wikipedia's data comes from primary sources (not always). You need primary source for example ITIS (Integrated Taxonomic Information System). This full data is intact and ready for use in different formats.

Q: Which services are typically required to scale a LAMP stack for high-traffic production environments? A:

  • If you have more reads than writes, consider using MySQL replicas for the reads. That lets you scale "reads" 'infinitely'.

  • The slowlog is a useful tool for identifying which queries need optimizing.

  • If you use any of the tools you mentioned on the same machine as the MySQL server, performance is likely to suffer. That is, giving InnoDB lots of RAM is likely to be better for caching and messaging.

  • "Don't queue it, just do it". -- I find this motto applies to MySQL in many situations. The queuing mechanism adds overhead and delays. If the queries come somewhat steadily, the queuing will bog down the entire system.

Q: Google App is Published on Internal Test Track but Can't Be Found/Downloaded A:

Answer for latest play console 2021. I was having the same problem but since play console is a lot different I didn't find any suitable solution but after trying a bit, this was the solution that worked for me.

Play Console > Setup > Internal App Sharing > Email Lists > Make sure your email list is checked and saved.

In uploader and tester section make sure 'Anyone you shared link with can download' is selected.

That's it.

I also created video on how this problem can be solved: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAiu76l4-7s

Q: SonarQube with Jest and react - Coverage on 0 New Lines to cover A:

Make sure the files

sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths=\**/output/coverage/jest/lcov.info
sonar.testExecutionReportPaths=**/reports/test-reporter.xml

are visible to Sonar.

In my case, it helped to solve the problem.

Q: Imacros script extract and save to csv A:

The second part of your question can be solved simply by adding one line after WAIT SECONDS=10 :

SET !EXTRACT {{!COL1}} .

The issue as to extraction seems to lie in a wrong TYPE=TD (or just in absence of any text, if ‘iMacros’ doesn’t return the ‘#EANF#’ value). Try to record again a click on the element you want to extract text from and compare the obtained command with your TAG POS=1 TYPE=TD ATTR=TXT:* EXTRACT=TXT .

Anyway you might test for example:

TAG POS=1 TYPE=TD ATTR=COLSPAN:5&&CLASS:style2 EXTRACT=TXT .
